Subject: Quick pilot onboarding — request for no-PO path

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Aaron from MerchantCo asked if we could start a 30-day pilots for two payment connectors next week. Their procurement is tight for small pilots and they asked whether we can be onboarded without a formal PO for this short trial.

Attached is our standard vendor intake and a one-page risk sheet. For pilots like this we typically accept an invoice-only path (net 30) with a small credit card hold for under $5k, but I wanted to check Redwood's policy and any required approvals.

Can you confirm:
- Whether Redwood has a documented short-term \"no-PO / invoice-only\" exception for pilot vendors under $5k?
- If not, what internal approvals we should route to get a temporary exception?

If it helps, Aaron included the pilot SOW and the expected spend estimate (under $1,800).

Appreciate the quick turn — MerchantCo is looking to start by 6/1.

Best,
Elaine
ProcureHQ Onboarding

Attachments: ProcureHQ_vendor_intake_form.pdf (application/pdf), merchantco_quick_risk_sheet.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Avery / Marcus —

We do have a temporary \"invoice-only\" path for trials under $2k that Procurement can approve, but it requires:
- Signed SOW from the customer and vendor agreeing to pilot scope and cancellation terms.
- Finance pre-authorization (Rishi) to allow invoice-only for this vendor for this amount.
- Vendor ID + W-9 on file and a quick risk check (which looks light from the sheet).
- A flag in the vendor record indicating the exception expiry date (auto-revert to PO-required after 30 days).

If you can get the signed SOW and a confirm of expected invoice total, I'll create the vendor record and mark the temporary allowance.

Priyom
Vendor Ops (Procurement)

Thanks for the details. Finance is OK to approve an invoice-only temporary exception for MerchantCo pilot under the following controls:
1) Exception limit: aggregate vendor spend for the pilot must not exceed $3,000.
2) Payment terms: Net 30; Finance will place a soft hold and mark as priority for collection if invoice is late.
3) Approval: Avery to confirm SOW + expected total; Priyom to document the exception in vendor record with expiry 2027-06-26.
4) Billing owner: Marcus to own invoicing contact and confirmation when pilot ends (and to confirm if we want to convert to PO later).

If all good, I'll sign off and route to AP to accept invoice-only for this vendor.

—Rishi
Head of Finance (Payments & Ops)
